study: Frozen512 preprocessing stress test after source-shift audit
scope: Exploratory sensitivity analysis on known images; no winner selection, refitting, threshold tuning or export change
model: Unchanged selected mobile512 research checkpoint and original thresholds; assert checkpoint hash and reproduce baseline logits
cases: All original512 calibration and test cases, fixed manifest, same paired cases across conditions

conditions.bilinear: Same full original image and letterbox geometry, Pillow BILINEAR instead of LANCZOS
conditions.center_crop: Center crop original grayscale image to its shorter edge square, then LANCZOS resize512; may remove anatomy, not a lung ROI
conditions.stretch: Original full grayscale image resized directly to512 square with LANCZOS; deliberate aspect distortion, not a clinical recommendation
conditions.gamma_0.8: Apply gamma0.8 to cached baseline uint8/255, round and clip back to uint8; black padding remains0

primary: Test classification-flip fraction center_crop versus baseline at unchanged logit0 threshold
secondary: All conditions in calibration and test: AUROC, sensitivity, specificity, NLL, risk_at80, fixed-confidence-threshold coverage/error, flips and mean absolute probability difference. Report all variants including harm.
bootstrap: 2000 paired test filename-group resamples, seed20261126, conditional on frozen model; no clinical/patient-identity guarantee
interpretation: Changed outputs show pipeline sensitivity, not lesion localization, causal shortcut proof or improved generalization. Calibration and test are from a known source family.
